text: yeah no i think i want every sort of logging to be forced to have to feed through some registry that puts every type of debugging log we ever have to instrument in as just a setting menu of toggles and then i get a z-indexed console that just gives me a raw feed i can copy pasta without needing to fuck around and have to say make sure you send that to the stdout or any of that shit
resolution: Recorded the diagnostics registry requirement in the design docs. Every debug/logging stream must register centrally with metadata and settings-menu toggles, and feed a z-indexed in-app raw console with copyable output. Stdout/file logs are allowed only as secondary sinks, not the primary debugging path.
